requirement.description: The hand-over from risk assessment to acceptance criteria is missing and has no trigger. This hand-over never existed in the pipeline configuration.
requirement.fact: The hand-over from risk assessment to acceptance criteria is missing and has no trigger.

narrator.name: Requirements Reuben
narrator.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: During the sprint review, {requirements_reuben} traced the workflow for new model releases. He observed that the security team completes the risk assessment document and files it in the shared drive. No automated task or manual step follows this action. The project management tool does not contain a ticket or dependency that links the completed assessment to the creation of acceptance criteria. Developers begin writing test cases based on their own interpretation of the requirements, without a formal hand over from the security team. The current pipeline configuration has no trigger that initiates the definition of acceptance criteria after the risk assessment is signed off. This gap exists for every release candidate currently in the backlog.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current state of the workflow and identifies a gap in the process without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs by the author or team members.
